moves.goal: have coals hot enough for cooking stones

moves.doing: tending the fire, setting fist-sized stones into the coals
moves.goal: heat stones to cook the rest of the grit

moves.doing: scooping pool water into the bark tray over the saved acorn grit
moves.goal: wet the meal and carry it to the fire

moves.doing: lifting a hot stone out of the coals with two sticks and dropping it into the bark tray of wet grit
moves.goal: cook the grit into gruel the old way

moves.doing: eating warm acorn gruel from the bark tray on the log seat by the fire
moves.goal: eat the first hot meal he has cooked from acorns

moves.doing: reading the slate on the log seat by the firelight
moves.goal: find out what a small yellow light low by the water at night could be

moves.doing: dipping a birch pen in the ink at the ink stone and writing the yellow light on a fresh notebook page
moves.goal: put down what he saw and what he read before he forgets the order of it

moves.doing: feeding the fire with dead branches from beside the ring
moves.goal: keep the fire going for the rest of the evening

moves.doing: resting on the log seat with his feet toward the coals
moves.goal: listen for the owls with a full belly

moves.doing: reading the slate on the log seat by the firelight
moves.goal: find out how to cook in the bark tray without burning it again

moves.doing: scooping pool water into the bark tray at the still pool
moves.goal: fill the tray to just under the fold for a boiling test

moves.doing: raking ash up around the bark tray on the coals with a stick
moves.goal: keep the flames off the bark above the water, the way the slate said

moves.doing: inspecting the steaming bark tray on the coals
moves.goal: see whether bark can really hold boiling water

moves.doing: reading the slate on the log seat by the firelight
moves.goal: find out how bark kettles keep their corners shut over a fire

moves.doing: whittling thin birch splinters into pins on the log seat
moves.goal: make skewer pins to hold the tray's corners instead of cord

moves.doing: inspecting the burned corner of the bark tray as he pins it with a birch splinter
moves.goal: fold the corner over outside and pin it, ready for a morning boil

moves.doing: reading the slate on the log seat by the last of the firelight
moves.goal: find out if acorns can be boiled sweet faster than the pool soaks them

moves.doing: dipping a birch pen in the ink at the ink stone and writing the boil plan in the notebook
moves.goal: get the morning's boil down on a page before he forgets the order of it

moves.doing: scraping ash over the coals with a stick and pushing the ring stones in
moves.goal: keep live coals under the ash for the morning boil

moves.doing: sleeping under his quilt on the moss bed
moves.goal: sleep before the morning boil
